resource.name: AI Video Studio
resource.creator: Kevin Vandermarliere
resource.description: Generates video and images through Fal.ai or ComfyUI from Resolve 21, with node workflows, bin integration and batch rendering. Creator lists Free and Studio on Windows/macOS; Linux is a separate early standalone build. Local models require suitable GPU resources; cloud providers and optional agents have separate costs. Version 3.1.7; no unambiguous release date.
resource.access: 💰 Paid plugin; cloud generation billed separately
